about.title: Simple, generous, always tasty.
about.body: A neighborhood kitchen designed for sharing: comforting products, generous portions and a menu that lets everyone find their favorite. Dine-in, takeaway or delivery, Like Food keeps the same promise: serving you something that will make you say "I like it".
about.serviceBody: A welcoming team, an accessible menu and dishes prepared to be enjoyed without waiting. That's the Like Food spirit: good, generous and uncomplicated.
